name: B10-0234/2026 (ECR) – New Chinese law on ‘ethnic unity and progress’ and the intensified suppression of ethnic identities
title: JOINT MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on the new Chinese law on ‘ethnic unity and progress’ and the intensified suppression of ethnic identities
part_text:
The European Parliament is not changing any law here. It is stating its opinion on a new Chinese law on "ethnic unity and progress", which it says forces minority groups to give up their languages, cultures and religions. It asks China to reverse these policies, asks European Union governments to consider sanctions on Chinese officials, and asks the United Nations human rights chief to report on how the law affects minority communities.

- **What changes:** Nothing yet. The Parliament only states its position and makes requests.
- **Who it affects:** China's Tibetan, Uyghur, Mongol and other minority communities, and Chinese officials who could face European Union sanctions.
- **What happens next:** The resolution goes to European Union governments, the European Commission, China's government and the United Nations human rights chief.
